html:
YuNet (Wu, Peng, Yu, Shenzhen University; libfacedetection.train): a tiny face detector (YuNet-n 75 k, YuNet-s 55 k parameters, OpenCV's FaceDetectorYN) that finds faces with a box and five landmarks. BSD-3-Clause code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: YuNet: A Tiny Millisecond-level Face Detector, Machine Intelligence Research 2023, 2023-05-15
  • Original code: https://github.com/ShiqiYu/libfacedetection.train at dca340aa082c
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/opencv/opencv_zoo/tree/main/models/face_detection_yunet (ONNX (OpenCV DNN)): The OpenCV Zoo ships the same network as ONNX for cv2.FaceDetectorYN; the PyTorch weights and the WIDER FACE evaluation are libfacedetection.train's.
  • Code licence: BSD-3-Clause (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: BSD-3-Clause
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/ShiqiYu/libfacedetection.train/blob/dca340aa082c71081a68d17db8e58b33a58a914b/LICENSE
  • Training data: WIDER FACE (32k images, 394k labelled faces) (WIDER FACE train with the SCRFD five-landmark annotations (labelv2), from scratch)
  • Options: score_threshold = 0.6 (0.0 to 1.0)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3
  • Variants: yunet-n, yunet-s
  • Outputs: keypoints, keypoint_scores, boxes, scores; label_set: face-5
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): yunet-n 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.6 reserved); yunet-s 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.6 reserved)
  • yunet-n 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 8 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 12 s (ONNX + engine).
  • yunet-s 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 8 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 13 s (ONNX + engine).
  • yunet-n original 1080x1920: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; libfacedetection.train build_yunet + YuNetPostprocessor (origin size, float32): upload, pad, network, NMS
  • yunet-s original 1080x1920: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; libfacedetection.train build_yunet + YuNetPostprocessor (origin size, float32): upload, pad, network, NMS
  • yunet-n load / first call: original 0.49 s / 0.477 s, portable 0.61 s / 0.23 s, kernels 1.91 s / 0.071 s
  • yunet-s load / first call: original 0.19 s / 0.009 s, portable 0.57 s / 0.281 s, kernels 0.59 s / 0.062 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

Each image at its own size, score threshold 0.02 and NMS IoU 0.45 (the authors' evaluation settings), the official toolkit's AP at IoU 0.5 over the subset's faces. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.001 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.1 and p99 <= 0.3 (absolute error of the output keypoints).

Limitations

  • module() exports the raw per-level head maps; decoding and NMS remain outside the exported graph.
  • No per-landmark confidence: keypoint_scores repeats the face score.
  • The image is not resized: faces much smaller than about 10 px are missed; large photos cost time in proportion to their pixels.
